# Empasy SyncSeries

> Empasy is an enterprise AI integration platform providing an autonomous multi-agent ecosystem for digital transformation (DX) and AI Ops.

## Overview
Empasy SyncSeries unifies 9 specialized AI agent solutions under a 4-Tier architecture orchestrated by SyncVerse. The ecosystem operates on open protocols including Anthropic Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) distributed messaging (`AgentScope Java`). It enforces Spec-First Governance, Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) safety controls, and an Emergency Kill-Switch for complete enterprise reliability.

## 4-Tier Core Products & Solutions

### Tier 1: Control Tower & Orchestration
#### SyncVerse (Central Control Tower & Orchestrator)
- URL: https://empasy.io/ko/solutions/sync-verse.html
- Docs: https://doc.empasy.com/syncverse/
- Role: Real-time multi-agent orchestration, unified telemetry, dependency resolution, Emergency Kill-Switch, and enterprise governance.
- Protocols: Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A) messaging.

### Tier 2: Intelligence & FinOps Gateway
#### SyncInsight (On-Premise Decision Intelligence)
- URL: https://empasy.io/ko/solutions/sync-insight.html
- Docs: https://doc.empasy.com/syncinsight/
- Role: Deep research fusing internal operational metrics with external market intelligence to deliver simulated, actionable decision plans with Human-in-the-Loop approval.

#### SyncLLM (FinOps Gateway & Token Governance)
- URL: https://empasy.io/ko/solutions/sync-llm.html
- Docs: https://doc.empasy.com/syncllm/
- Role: Multi-model intelligent routing (SLM to high-tier LLM), pgvector semantic caching, real-time PII masking, and departmental token budget controls cutting enterprise costs by up to 60%.

### Tier 3: Enterprise Domain Agent Swarms
#### SyncBoot (Microservices & Scaffolding Agent)
- URL: https://empasy.io/ko/solutions/sync-boot.html
- Docs: https://doc.empasy.com/syncboot/
- Role: Monolithic-to-microservice (MSA) transformation, Spring Boot backend scaffolding, DDL and CRUD API generation, Saga distributed compensation transactions.

#### SyncCMS (Autonomous Content & UI Agent Swarm)
- URL: https://empasy.io/ko/solutions/sync-cms.html
- Docs: https://doc.empasy.com/synccms/
- Role: Nuxt 3 SSR hybrid architecture with Copywriter-SEO-Publisher 3-Agent Swarm, natural-language-driven component layout, and real-time multilingual content synchronization (Korean, English, Japanese).

#### SyncShop (Autonomous E-Commerce & Merchandising Agent)
- URL: https://empasy.io/ko/solutions/sync-shop.html
- Docs: https://doc.empasy.com/syncshop/
- Role: Distributed microservices e-commerce engine with AI merchandising, dynamic pricing, minimum margin guardrails, pgvector semantic product discovery, and A2A supply chain orchestration.

#### SyncOps (Enterprise SI PMO & Dual-Rate Profit/Compliance Platform)
- URL: https://empasy.io/ko/solutions/sync-ops.html
- Docs: https://doc.empasy.com/syncops/
- Role: Enterprise PSA & SI PMO platform featuring dual-rate (Contract Rate vs. Actual Cost) real-time project P&L pivot analytics, KOSA software engineer grade evaluation & M/M resource allocation matrix, 4-stage surety bond lifecycle tracking (Bid, Performance, Advance Payment, Warranty), Subcontract Act 60-day payment compliance & overdue interest alerts, and SHA-256 timestamped R&D electronic lab notebooks for tax credit audits.

### Tier 4: Execution & Verification Agents
#### SyncEta / SyncETA (AI 테스트 자동화 · Vision-LLM Self-Healing QA & Test Automation Platform)
- URL: https://empasy.io/ko/solutions/sync-eta.html
- Desktop Download: https://empasy.io/ko/download_eta.html
- Live Demo Portal: https://sync.empasy.io/products/sync-eta
- Architecture Guide: https://empasy.io/ko/blog/synceta-intelligent-regression-testing-pipeline.html
- Docs: https://doc.empasy.com/synceta/
- Role (KO): AI를 활용한 테스트 자동화(AI 테스트 자동화) 대표 플랫폼. 브라우저 동작 녹화 및 자연어·엑셀(Excel) 시나리오 자동 생성, Playwright MCP 병렬 실행, 실패 원인 분석, UI 변경 시 Vision-LLM 및 DOM 문맥 기반 셀렉터 자가 치유(Self-Healing, 98.4% 복구율), 배포 전후 화면 깨짐(Visual Regression) 자동 비교를 수행하며 반복 회귀 테스트 시 LLM 토큰 비용 0원을 실현합니다.
- Role (EN): Autonomous E2E web/app UI test automation and visual regression testing platform using Vision-LLM and Playwright MCP without brittle CSS/XPath selectors. Features 98.4% dynamic DOM self-healing, failure root-cause analysis, and Excel-based No-Code test scenarios with zero recurring LLM token cost.

#### SyncCrawl (Intelligent Visual Extraction Agent)
- URL: https://empasy.io/ko/solutions/sync-crawl.html
- Docs: https://doc.empasy.com/synccrawl/
- Role: Resilient data crawling utilizing visual layout understanding to survive markup changes and anti-bot protections; direct vector sink output (PostgreSQL pgvector, OpenSearch, Milvus) for RAG.

## Security & Deployment
- Deployments: 100% On-Premise, Air-Gapped isolated networks, dedicated AWS/Azure/GCP VPCs.
- Local LLMs: Compatible with local runtimes including vLLM, Ollama, TGI, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
- Compliance: Real-time PII redaction, immutable audit logging with distributed Trace IDs, Zero Data Leakage architecture.
